label: enemies
description: Jester skull-clown enemy, 2 actions x 5 frames
original_prompt:
Hand-painted circus-style sprite sheet of "Jester", a sinister clown-jester enemy for a side-scrolling game. He has a gaunt white skull-like face with hollow black eye sockets, a wide grinning mouth full of sharp teeth, and a small red clown nose; his skin is pale bone-white with dark shading. Around his head/shoulders he wears a large ruff collar made of glossy deep-red flower petals (like a blooming poppy or peony), each petal tipped with a tiny gold bead. His costume is a tattered jester outfit: a red-and-cream vertically striped bodice and puffed striped legs/trousers, ragged frilled cuffs and hem in cream and gold, dark leather boots with curled pointed toes and gold bells at the tips, and long clawed black-gloved hands with exaggerated fingers. His expression is menacing and theatrical — a twisted grin, glowing red eyes. Art style: painterly hand-drawn animation, bold clean outlines, warm saturated colors (deep crimson reds, bone white, gold accents, dark browns), dynamic hunched forward-leaning poses, subtle motion smears on fast moves.

Sheet layout: 2 rows x 5 columns on a solid pink background with a faint light grid dividing the cells. Each row is one action, left to right:

Row 1 — Run cycle (5 frames): a loping, hunched sprint across the frame, body leaning forward, arms pumping with clawed hands, striped legs striding, petal-ruff swaying, contact -> down -> passing -> up -> contact.

Row 2 — Attack/lunge (5 frames): a leaping, lunging attack — rising -> apex -> falling toward the player, both clawed arms flung out wide, then a final impact frame showing him slamming down low with a splash/burst of red petal debris and dust at his feet.

Character faces right, consistent proportions and palette across all 10 frames.
